يحونصل (form IIIq)
# يَحْوَنْصِلُ (yaḥwanṣilu) /jaħ.wan.sˤi.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِحْوَنْصَلَ (iḥwanṣala)
# يَحْوَنْصِلَ (yaḥwanṣila) /jaħ.wan.sˤi.la/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْوَنْصَلَ (iḥwanṣala)
# يَحْوَنْصِلْ (yaḥwanṣil) /jaħ.wan.sˤil/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِحْوَنْصَلَ
